about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me better
about.bio: I'm a full stack developer focused on Java, Spring Boot and Angular. Since October 2020 I've worked at WICO Technology on SoluBat, a building-management ERP serving 1,000+ users across 10+ modules. I worked there part-time during my software engineering studies at ESPRIT and have been full-time since 2025. I care about fast screens, solid tests and clean releases. On the side, I build Veinpal, my own set of web and desktop tools.
